title: Sara Duterte admits 'painful small talk' with senators amid OVP budget debates
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte said Friday she had a “painful small talk” with certain senators during her visit to the Senate yesterday for the plenary deliberations on the proposed budget of her…

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte said Friday she had a “painful small talk” with certain senators during her visit to the Senate yesterday for the plenary deliberations on the proposed budget of her office for 2027.
Duterte said this in a press conference, stressing that the “national sport” of politicians is pretending to be nice to each other or being two-faced.
“It was a painful small talk… you know, ‘yung pambansang sport ng mga pulitiko is plastikan,” she said.
“So it’s painful when you’re doing it. For me, for others they’re very good at it,” she added.
The Senate on Thursday afternoon swiftly approved the proposed P785.2 million budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) for fiscal year 2027.

Duterte was physically present in the Senate session hall when the proposed OVP budget was presented. She was accompanied by OVP chief of staff Zuleika Lopez, OVP Assistant Chief of Staff Lemuel Ortonio, and other officials.
But the Vice President said some of her friends and supporters reacted negatively to her interactions with some lawmakers during her recent Senate visit.
“They’re not happy, marami ang hindi masaya kahapon na mga kaibigan at supporters. Makikita mo ‘yan sa mga group chat ko,” Duterte said.
Asked for her personal reaction, “Ako, I am okay. It was part of my work, I went there for the Office of the Vice President since we need the budget to operate for the year 2027.”
“I don’t have feelings about except that I had to appease many people yesterday because they were not happy with the chitchat,” she added.

The Vice President was seen yesterday interacting with Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian, Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente Sotto III, Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zuburi, and Senate Finance chairman JV Ejercito.
She was also seen talking with known allies Senators Bong Go and Robin Padilla. —AOL, GMA News
